overview.description: The Themes Uranium & Nuclear ETF (URAN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund tracks an index of companies from around the world associated with the uranium and nuclear industries. The fund selects and weights companies based on revenue-based thematic scores. URAN was launched on Sep 24, 2024 and is issued by Themes.
